commands.command: sudo install -d /etc/apt/keyrings && curl -fsSL https://hub.unity3d.com/linux/keys/public | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/unityhub.gpg

commands.method: apt: add repository file /etc/apt/sources.list.d/unityhub.sources (DEB822: Types deb, URIs https://hub.unity3d.com/linux/repos/deb, Suites stable, Components main, Signed-By /etc/apt/keyrings/unityhub.gpg)

commands.command: sudo apt update && sudo apt install unityhub

commands.method: dnf (RHEL/CentOS/Fedora, page says not officially supported): add repo and install
commands.command: sudo dnf check-update && sudo dnf install unityhub

note: The official Unity docs give apt, dnf and AppImage routes; apt and AppImage are the main ones, and the page's heredoc and dnf repo block were condensed here.
